_about: Publishing queue for the biweekly article routine. Topics come from the site's own Semrush positions export (volume/KD) and Google Search Console (impressions/position), prioritised for low keyword difficulty, solid volume and no existing page that already targets the cluster. The routine publishes the first entry with status 'queued', then sets it to 'published' with the date. When the queue runs low, add new entries using the same rules (see ARTICLE_PLAYBOOK.md).
